scenes.text: Hi there, bus counselor! Let's learn the friendliest part of your day: texting a family.
Open Bus Comms on your own phone, and there's every family on your bus. In a hurry? Just start typing a camper's or parent's name.
Tap a family, and their thread opens. Everything you've sent them today is right here.
Type your message. Keep it short, kind and clear. Like: 'Hi! Maya's bus is running about ten minutes late. Everyone's okay!'
Tap the arrow. When you see 'Sent' with a check mark, it's on its way.
No signal? No worries! If a text doesn't go through, it stays right there in the box. Just tap the arrow again when you're back online.
Every bus also has Quick Message, ready-made texts for the updates you send most. Look for it on your bus screen, and send it with one tap.
One last thing: text families only through Bus Comms. Never tap a phone number in CampInTouch, because that calls from your own phone. Thanks for taking such good care of our campers!
